text.p: These are the main stories in Slovenia's Tuesday morning newspapers:

- The Slovenian parliament amended the constitution on Monday to allow foreigners to buy land, clearing the last hurdle to ratification of the association agreement with the European Union, which is expected on Tuesday.
- The Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) holds a seminar on Tuesday to analyse the current state of Slovenia's economy.
- According to initial estimates, hail in Prekmurje, Eastern Slovenia, damaged between 60 to 90 percent of all crops in the region.
- Slovenia's apartment fund approved 1.5 billion tolars ($9.2 million) worth of apartment loans to young families.
- Credit rating agency Dun & Bradstreet (D&B) awarded Slovenia an unchanged DB3a rating, making Slovenia and the Czech Republic the joint top rated countries in the region.
- Slovenia's biggest domestic appliances producer Gorenje said it increased its production to 7,000 home appliances per day from 6,500 items per day.
